displayName: UE4 static shadow-depth caster vertex family
description: Vertex family that transforms non-skinned geometry and emits ShadowDepth plus SV_POSITION for shadow-map rasterization without reading a bone buffer.

hashFastPaths.evidence: Verified full-interpolant static ShadowDepth caster variant.
Verified position-only static ShadowDepth caster variant.

checks.meaning: The DXBC output signature explicitly contains the ShadowDepth semantic.
Static caster variants do not read buffered bone matrices.
A three-component object-space position enters the static transform path.
The rasterizer position is emitted once.
The static object position enters a constant-buffer matrix transform.
Subsequent matrix rows accumulate the transformed position.
This is the vertex caster stage, not the later pixel depth writer.

runtimeContract.output: static shadow-map caster position and ShadowDepth interpolant
adapterMustConfirm: paired material-coverage pixel shader when present
runtimeContract.controlSafety: Keep this family separate from the skinned caster family and from receiver-side shadow filtering.
